categories.main_business_segments: Sundrug operates two main business segments: the Drugstore Business, which focuses on the retail and wholesale of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, and some food products; and the Discount Store Business, which primarily sells food and household goods through its subsidiary Direx. The group also includes pharmacy operations and related services through its network of subsidiaries and affiliates.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digitalization and operational efficiency technologies, such as POS systems, electronic shelf labels, semi/self-checkout registers, and expiry date management systems. It emphasizes low-cost operations through IT-driven logistics, centralized procurement, and productivity improvements, as well as the development of private brand products with a focus on environmental sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sundrug primarily serves general consumers seeking pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, and food products. Its customer base includes individuals and families, with a growing emphasis on health-conscious and aging populations, as well as inbound tourists. The company also targets local communities through its pharmacy and healthcare services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates exclusively in Japan, with a nationwide store network covering all major regions, including Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto, Chubu, Kansai, Chugoku, Shikoku, and Kyushu. There is no significant overseas business, but its e-commerce platform offers delivery to 196 countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sundrug is positioned at the downstream end of the supply chain as a retailer and wholesaler, directly serving end consumers through its stores and online channels. It also acts as a distributor for some products and operates its own logistics centers for efficient supply chain management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding high-quality new store openings, strengthening e-commerce and digital transformation, enhancing pharmacy and prescription services, and developing environmentally friendly private brand products. The company is also focused on sustainability, productivity improvements, and human capital development, with no significant in-house R&D for new technologies but ongoing investment in operational innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of products at physical stores and online, including pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, and food. Additional revenue streams include prescription dispensing, private brand product sales, and a customer loyalty points program. There is no significant subscription or licensing revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other large Japanese drugstore chains such as MatsukiyoCocokara & Company, Welcia, and Tsuruha. Sundrug is positioned as one of the leading drugstore operators in Japan, with a strong focus on low-cost operations, nationwide coverage, and a growing presence in discount retailing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales reached 801.8 billion yen, with operating profit of 44.5 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 30.8 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth, with sales increasing by 6.7% year-on-year and a robust store expansion strategy, maintaining a healthy financial position and a self-capital ratio of over 60%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sundrug emphasizes 'safety, trust, and convenience' as its core value proposition, offering a wide selection of daily essentials at competitive prices, supported by efficient operations and digital innovation. The company differentiates itself through its extensive store network, private brand development (including eco-friendly products), integrated pharmacy services, and a strong focus on customer service and community health needs.
